items.source: Possibly overrides customizations made with the "spring.elasticsearch.rest" configuration properties namespace. For more targeted changes, see:
items.translation: 可能会覆盖使用 "spring.elasticsearch.rest" 配置属性命名空间所做的自定义。如需更针对性的更改，请参阅：

items.source: Customize the HttpAsyncClientBuilder. Unlike Rest5ClientBuilder.setHttpClientConfigCallback(Consumer), implementing this method does not replace other customization of the HTTP client builder.
items.translation: 自定义 HttpAsyncClientBuilder。与 Rest5ClientBuilder.setHttpClientConfigCallback(Consumer) 不同，实现此方法不会替换对 HTTP 客户端构建器的其他自定义操作。

items.source: Customize the RequestConfig.Builder. Unlike Rest5ClientBuilder.setRequestConfigCallback(Consumer), implementing this method does not replace other customization of the request config builder.
items.translation: 自定义 RequestConfig.Builder。与 Rest5ClientBuilder.setRequestConfigCallback(Consumer) 不同，实现此方法不会替换对其他请求配置构建器的自定义。

items.source: Customize the PoolingAsyncClientConnectionManagerBuilder. Unlike Rest5ClientBuilder.setConnectionManagerCallback(Consumer), implementing this method does not replace other customization of the connection manager builder.
items.translation: 自定义 PoolingAsyncClientConnectionManagerBuilder。与 Rest5ClientBuilder.setConnectionManagerCallback(Consumer) 不同，实现此方法不会替换对连接管理器构建器的其他自定义操作。

items.source: Customize the ConnectionConfig.Builder. Unlike Rest5ClientBuilder.setConnectionConfigCallback(Consumer), implementing this method does not replace other customization of the connection config builder.
items.translation: 自定义 ConnectionConfig.Builder。 与 Rest5ClientBuilder.setConnectionConfigCallback(Consumer) 不同，实现此方法不会替换对连接配置构建器的其他自定义操作。

items.source: Brian Clozel, Vedran Pavic, Andy Wilkinson
items.translation: Brian Clozel, Vedran Pavic, Andy Wilkinson

items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the Rest5ClientBuilder to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it creates a Rest5Client.
items.translation: 可被子 Bean 实现以自定义 Rest5ClientBuilder，从而在创建 Rest5Client 之前微调其自动配置的回调接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
